stem:
Triangle KLM is shown with dimensions given in units.

Which figure best models the area formula for triangle KLM?

options.label: A
options.text: Parallelogram with base 16 and height 9 formed by duplicating the original triangle along side length 10.

options.label: B
options.text: Parallelogram with base 16 and height 9 formed by extending the triangle along side length 10 horizontally.

options.label: C
options.text: Parallelogram with base 16 and height 10 formed by duplicating the original triangle along side length 9 vertically.

options.label: D
options.text: Parallelogram oriented horizontally with base 16, height 9, and side 10, formed to extend the triangle.

visual_elements: Triangle KLM diagram with right angle at L, KL = 10, LM = 16, and altitude from L to KM = 9.
Option A diagram: parallelogram with base 16, height 9, side 10, showing the shaded triangle.
Option B diagram: parallelogram with base 16, height 9, side 10, showing the shaded triangle extended horizontally.
Option C diagram: parallelogram with base 16, height 10, side 9, showing the shaded triangle extended vertically.
Option D diagram: parallelogram with base 16, height 9, side 10 horizontally oriented showing shaded triangle.
